feed_accounts.description: List of feed accounts (RSS/Atom URLs to subscribe to). Each item must define a URL; other fields are optional with safe defaults per plugin documentation behavior.

feed_accounts.items.description: Fields for each feed account entry.

feed_accounts.items.url.description: Feed URL (required). Must be a valid RSS/Atom feed.

feed_accounts.items.interval.description: Feed update interval in minutes. Plugin uses 30 as default.

feed_accounts.items.max_age.description: Maximum age (in days) of articles to retain. 0 means unlimited.

feed_accounts.items.max_articles.description: Maximum number of articles per feed to keep. Plugin defaults to 100.

global_use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS for feed downloads when supported by the server.

global_verify_ssl.description: Verify SSL certificates for secure feed connections.

global_proxy_url.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL to use for feed downloads (e.g., 'http://proxy.example.com:8080'). Leave empty to use system/no proxy.
